text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-Japanese...Non Japanese...or Ghosts? What is the truth in the Red Army issue.
-Pope John Paul II received Prime Minister Hariri for 35 minutes: very happy to visit Lebanon in May.
-Lebanese authorities decided to deport an Iraqi citizen Bassam Yaaqoub Youssef, after questioning him about the killings of several Iraqi opposition figures outside Lebanon.
-Head of the Higher Shi'ite Council Imam Shamseddine after meeting Egyptian President Mobarak: There is no doubt abour the Arab identity of Shi'ites.
-Israeli artillery shelled south Lebanon areas facing Israel's occupation zone.
-The Pope received Lebanon's Maronite Patriarch Cardinal Sfeir.
-Central Bank Governor says treasury bill rates should stabilise around their current levels.
-Yields continued to fall on Lebanese treasury bills.
-Head of Parliament Berri to Kuwait in March.
